title: Provisioning workflow: a paid entitlement creates the tenant, idempotently
description:
Outcome: Implements PPY-8bb56d. When Prospectus says an Account holds a paid shared-tier site (the event or route named by PPY-6d9a6d), one workflow, keyed by a replay id, creates: the Tenant row (state active), the first TenantMembership (the buyer as admin), the TenantDomain for the chosen subdomain and its KVS entry, the default SiteDocuments from the starter template (PPY-3aa10f), the tenant's NewsroomSections, its canonical KnowledgeCorpus ("<tenant>.canonical"), its Cyclotron id ("<cyclotronId>-<tenant>", docs/multi-tenancy.md "Site cyclotron"), zeroed usage counters, and queues the first full projection. Each step is idempotent; a failure resumes from the last finished step. Payment comes first: no tenant exists before it.

Data-only trigger (Ryan, 2026-11-08; Prospectus kanbus-271b4a): the trigger is a Prospectus deployment record for product papyrus, created by an operator for the partner and by self-serve checkout from M8; the design partner's three deployments at M7 are its first production runs, delivered as a deployment.changed event (asked on PPY-966ef5) with a reconcile sweep over deployments changed since a cursor as the backstop. The workflow never trusts the event body: it re-reads the deployment and the Account's entitlement and billing standing from Prospectus. Idempotency key: deployment id plus revision. Nothing in it edits a file, deploys, changes the Cognito callback list or issues a certificate. The first scenario is renamed from "A paid sign-up creates one tenant even when the event repeats" to "A deployment record creates one tenant even when the event repeats".

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new amplify/functions/tenant-provisioning/ (a Step Functions state machine or a resumable Lambda), src/papyrus_content/tenancy.py, the Prospectus events consumer (amplify/plugins/prospectus-events/, as specified in PPY-a1e75a part C).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-provisioning.feature):
Scenario: A deployment record creates one tenant even when the event repeats
    Given Prospectus sends the deployment.changed event for "harbour-news" twice
    When provisioning runs
    Then one Tenant, one admin membership and one subdomain exist and the first projection was queued once

Scenario: A half-finished provisioning resumes
    Given provisioning stopped after creating the sections
    When the event is delivered again
    Then it continues from the corpus step and finishes

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-6d9a6d, PPY-31c45c, PPY-c020ce, PPY-3aa10f, PPY-82de58, PPY-0bb0fd. Blocks PPY-810f42. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-8bb56d, PPY-e54eca.

Testing: Behave with a fake Prospectus event source; staging end to end.
Rollout: Staging first; production for internal test tenants, then the design partner's three deployments at M7; self-serve from M8.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a tenant is created without payment through a replayed or forged event. Mitigation: the consumer verifies the event's signature or source and re-reads the entitlement from Prospectus before creating.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged (runs with the platform provisioning role).
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
